present.label: Read the input
present.story: {n} passengers will board. We want the longest run with no badge twice.
present.formal: len(s) = {n}. Find the longest substring without a repeated character.

initialize.label: Open the window
initialize.story: The window is empty and nothing has been seen yet.

read:new.label: Board a passenger
read:new.story: Passenger {right} wears {char}, a badge not seen before.

read:outside.label: Board a passenger
read:outside.story: Passenger {right} wears {char}. It was seen at {lastIndex}, but that passenger is already behind the window, so it does not count.
read:outside.formal: s[{right}] = '{char}', last['{char}'] = {lastIndex} < left: no repeat inside the window.

read:repeat.label: A familiar badge
read:repeat.story: Passenger {right} wears {char}, and another {char} sits inside the window at {lastIndex}.
read:repeat.formal: s[{right}] = '{char}', last['{char}'] = {lastIndex} ≥ left: a repeat inside the window.

jump.label: Move the back of the window
jump.story: The window must start after the earlier {char}, so its back jumps from {from} to {to}.

measure:record.label: Measure
measure:record.story: The window runs from {left} to {right}: {length} passengers, a new longest.

measure:keep.label: Measure
measure:keep.story: The window runs from {left} to {right}: {length} passengers. The longest stays {best}.

done.label: Return the longest
done.story: Everyone has boarded. The longest run without a repeat is {best}, from {start} to {end}.
